description:
Dig your way through a world of underground puzzles in this fun and addictive adventure.

Use your shovel to carve paths through dirt and sand, guiding streams of balls toward hungry underground creatures. Each stage challenges you to think ahead, plan your routes carefully, and make the most of every ball as you work your way deeper underground.

Across 50 handcrafted levels spread over 5 unique worlds, you'll encounter a variety of enemies including carnivorous plants, dragons, giant worms, salamanders, and bats. Every stage contains three smaller enemies that must be defeated to earn stars. Feed them enough balls and they'll release a star. Collect all three stars, then take on the larger boss waiting at the bottom of the level to complete the stage.

But digging a simple path won't be enough. As you progress, new obstacles and mechanics are introduced that transform each level into a clever puzzle. Navigate around lava pits, dodge deadly lasers, avoid spinning blockers, slip past rotating laser traps, time your movements around pulsing laser beams, and work around immovable rocks. Discover special gates that multiply your balls and use them strategically to ensure you have enough resources to defeat every enemy and boss.

The early stages are easy to learn, but the challenge steadily grows as new obstacles combine in increasingly complex ways. Success requires careful planning, smart path creation, and creative problem solving.

Can you dig the perfect path and defeat every underground threat?
